proposedTypes: Shared intrusive link with true previous/next pointers, after actual unlink evidence
Interval node as link plus u16 first/last, with arena-owning sentinel ring modeled separately
Tagged label payload as a two-byte union of u16 character and u8 control index
Compiled-state collection link plus typed data payload, replacing only fields whose pointer/scalar roles are evidenced

evidence.role: Range-node previous/next pointers are read, dereferenced and rewritten during unlink/split; ring owner is passed to arena allocate/free.
Label constructor initializes ring head to itself and its arena owner at label+16 to null.
Label destructor reads arena owner at label+16 and releases each range node through it.
Tagged label copy handles u16 singleton and only one control payload byte; range-list owner and bounds are copied distinctly.
Compiled-state payload constructor initializes two link heads, arena owner fields, membership pointer/count and signed-byte result.
Compiled-state payload initialization identifies arena pointers, raw membership bytes and count; no pointer is packed into scalar storage.
Compiled-state outer collection link and data payload are separately constructed and used.

Arena request of three logical blocks returns raw compiled-state node; payload construction receives node+8; STM writes old collection-head previous and head address into node offsets0/4, followed by head.previous=node and previous.next=node.

openReview: NFA state collection-prefix construction is a separate still-unqualified class; no promotion of that class is claimed.
Compiler ARM body/hash and relocation invariance must be measured after approved shared type changes.
changesToFrozenFiles: Authorized successor versions; exact published predecessor packets/verification and commit provenance preserved.
